info.title: Ultrivly API
info.description: Ultrivly helpdesk API. Organization routes accept a session cookie or a bearer API key. Lists use cursor pagination (limit 1-100, cursor = next_cursor from the previous page). Errors use the Error schema. POST requests under /api/v1/orgs/{org_id}/ accept an Idempotency-Key header. Every response carries an x-request-id header to quote in support requests.
